jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide dates for participating firms)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide window for NSW signatory firms: applications open 9:00am AEST on 9 June 2027; the Law Society lists two closing dates (11:59pm 4 July and 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so the earlier date is given here and students should confirm with each firm; offers can be made from 8 September 2027 and must be accepted/declined by 1:00pm 9 September 2027; eligibility is final or penultimate year of study.
Currently open on the firm's own graduate careers site, closing Monday 2 November 2026; the original opening date is not published on the page so 'opens' is left null.

jobs.program: Dive In Program, May 2027 intake (pre-clerkship insight program)
jobs.notes: Confirmed future opening — the firm states applications for the May 2027 program will open in March 2027, but only the month is published, so no exact open or close date can be given; aimed at pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd year LLB or 1st year JD).
